## 2026-10-04 - Dynamic Header Controls & i18n Attribute Translations
**Learning:** Dynamic header controls generated by JavaScript modules (like `i18n.js`) require semantic `<button type="button">` elements with explicit `data-i18n-title` and `data-i18n-aria-label` attributes to ensure screen reader accessibility, hover tooltips, and keyboard navigation across language switches. Extending `applyTranslations()` in `i18n.js` to process `data-i18n-title` and `data-i18n-aria-label` ensures accessibility attributes stay synchronized when switching languages.
**Action:** Always render interactive header toggles as semantic `<button type="button">` elements with `:focus-visible` CSS focus rings and `data-i18n-title` / `data-i18n-aria-label` attributes for dynamic i18n translation.
